ev.q: Ally McBeal is an American legal comedy-drama television series
the main focus of the series is the romantic and personal lives of the main characters
many offbeat and frequently surreal running gags and themes
The show uses vivid, dramatic fantasy sequences for Ally's and other characters' wishful thinking
The series also featured regular visits to a local bar where singer Vonda Shepard regularly performed
originally aired on Fox from September 8, 1997, to May 20, 2002
